relay.chrome.session.subtitle.not_answer.note: The relay SPA's own subtitle word for the YELLOW status dot: the session's process is alive but not answering (its runtime is unreachable or its heartbeat and frames have both been quiet past the relay's window). Reused here verbatim so the two clients cannot name one state two ways. Its explanation is relay.health.dropped_detail or relay.health.quiet_detail, depending on which cause won.

relay.chrome.session.subtitle.ended.note: The relay SPA's own subtitle word for the GREY status dot: the relay proved the session's process gone (or the row is a history-only rebuild with pid 0). History is kept and the session is resumable, which relay.health.ended_detail explains. Reused here verbatim.

relay.chrome.session.resume.note: The relay SPA's own Resume label, adopted verbatim so the two clients cannot offer one action two ways. It reopens an ended session in its home folder.

relay.chrome.session.resuming.note: The relay SPA's own in-flight label for Resume: the reopen has been asked for and has not answered yet. Ellipsis is meaningful.

relay.chrome.session.subtitle.working.note: Mirrored verbatim from the core relay catalogue (local_operator/i18n/catalogues/en/relay.chrome.context.json). Owned relay SPA chrome for the borderless redesign (docs/design/mobile-relay-redesign.md). Liveness line under the conversation title while the agent works. {elapsed} is an ALREADY-FORMATTED compact duration such as '1m36s'; do not reformat it. Keep the middle dot.

relay.chrome.session.subtitle.working_pl.note: Mirrored verbatim from the core relay catalogue (local_operator/i18n/catalogues/en/relay.chrome.context.json). Owned relay SPA chrome for the borderless redesign (docs/design/mobile-relay-redesign.md). Liveness line while the agent works and its start time is unknown.

relay.chrome.session.subtitle.waiting.note: Mirrored verbatim from the core relay catalogue (local_operator/i18n/catalogues/en/relay.chrome.context.json). Owned relay SPA chrome for the borderless redesign (docs/design/mobile-relay-redesign.md). Liveness line while the agent is stopped on an approval the operator must give.

relay.chrome.session.subtitle.idle.note: Mirrored verbatim from the core relay catalogue (local_operator/i18n/catalogues/en/relay.chrome.context.json). Owned relay SPA chrome for the borderless redesign (docs/design/mobile-relay-redesign.md). Liveness line while the agent is not working and nothing is pending.

relay.chrome.session.tray.tasks.note: Mirrored verbatim from the core relay catalogue (local_operator/i18n/catalogues/en/relay.chrome.context.json). Owned relay SPA chrome for the borderless redesign (docs/design/mobile-relay-redesign.md). Pill for the session's task list; opens it. {done} of {total} tasks are finished. Keep the slash form; it is a compact fraction. Native difference: the core writes {x, number}; this runtime has no number argument type, so the placeholders are plain {x}. The values are small integers, so the painted text is identical.

relay.chrome.session.tray.agents.note: Mirrored verbatim from the core relay catalogue (local_operator/i18n/catalogues/en/relay.chrome.context.json). Owned relay SPA chrome for the borderless redesign (docs/design/mobile-relay-redesign.md). Pill for the session's subagents (helper agents it started); opens their list. {running} of {total} are running now. Native difference: the core writes {x, number}; this runtime has no number argument type, so the placeholders are plain {x}. The values are small integers, so the painted text is identical.
